words.example: A big letter starts a name.
I can read the bus sign.
The bus is at the stop.
Letters are in our daily life.

lessons.title: Letters around us
lessons.en:
Anna: Look! There are letters on the sign.
Ben: Yes! I can see a big letter B and a small letter s.
Anna: This is the bus sign. B-U-S, bus!
Ben: Letters are everywhere in our life.
Anna: Let's find more letters on the way to school.
lessons.cn:
安娜：看！招牌上有字母。
本：是的！我看到一个大写字母 B 和一个小写字母 s。
安娜：这是公交车标志。B-U-S，bus！
本：字母在我们生活中无处不在。
安娜：我们去上学的路上再找找更多字母吧。

lessons.title: The ABC song
lessons.en:
We have 26 letters in the alphabet.
Some letters are big, and some are small.
We see them on signs, on a bus, and in books.
We use letters to write our names.
Letters help us read the world. How nice!
lessons.cn:
字母表里有 26 个字母。
有些字母是大写的，有些是小写的。
我们在招牌上、公交车上、书里看到它们。
我们用字母写自己的名字。
字母帮助我们读懂世界。多棒呀！

words.example: This word is new to me.

lessons.title: Two languages
lessons.en:
Mr Lin: We have English and Chinese in class.
Lily: How do you say "book" in Chinese?
Mr Lin: We say "shu". It means the same thing.
Lily: English and Chinese words can be different, but they can mean the same!
Mr Lin: Right. Let's read them together.
lessons.cn:
林老师：课堂上我们有英语和汉语。
莉莉："book" 用汉语怎么说？
林老师：我们说"书"。它的意思是一样的。
莉莉：英语和汉语的单词可以不同，但意思可以相同！
林老师：对。我们一起来读吧。

lessons.title: Same and different
lessons.en:
English and Chinese are two languages.
The words look different, but some things are the same.
We say "hello" in English. We say "ni hao" in Chinese.
They mean the same: a friendly hello!
It is fun to read and say words in two languages.
lessons.cn:
英语和汉语是两种语言。
单词看起来不同，但有些东西是相同的。
我们用英语说 "hello"。我们用汉语说"你好"。
它们意思相同：一句友好的问候！
用两种语言读和说单词很有趣。

lessons.title: Who is he?
lessons.en:
Kate: Look at the photo. Who is he?
Sam: He is my friend, Tom. He is a boy in Class 2.
Kate: And who is she?
Sam: She is my classmate, Lily.
Kate: Is she your teacher?
Sam: No, she isn't. Our teacher is Miss Wang.
lessons.cn:
凯特：看这张照片。他是谁？
山姆：他是我的朋友汤姆。他是二班的一个男孩。
凯特：那她是谁？
山姆：她是我的同学莉莉。
凯特：她是你的老师吗？
山姆：不，她不是。我们的老师是王老师。

lessons.title: My friends
lessons.en:
I have many friends at school.
He is Tom. He is a happy boy.
She is Lily. She is a kind girl.
Miss Wang is our teacher. We all like her.
A friend, a classmate, a teacher — they make my school day warm.
lessons.cn:
我在学校有很多朋友。
他是汤姆。他是个快乐的男孩。
她是莉莉。她是个善良的女孩。
王老师是我们的老师。我们都喜欢她。
一个朋友、一个同学、一位老师——他们让我的校园生活很温暖。

lessons.title: Colour the keys
lessons.en:
Teacher: Let's colour the keyboard today.
Mike: What colour is this key?
Teacher: Colour it red, please.
Mike: And this one?
Teacher: That key is blue. Now click the green key.
Mike: A red, blue, yellow and green keyboard. So nice!
lessons.cn:
老师：今天我们来给键盘上色。
迈克：这个按键是什么颜色？
老师：请把它涂成红色。
迈克：这个呢？
老师：那个键是蓝色的。现在点击绿色的键。
迈克：一个红、蓝、黄、绿的键盘。真漂亮！

lessons.title: A colourful keyboard
lessons.en:
I have a keyboard with many keys.
I colour the keys in four colours.
This key is red. That key is blue.
Here is a yellow key, and there is a green one.
I click the keys and type my name. What fun!
lessons.cn:
我有一个有很多按键的键盘。
我把按键涂成四种颜色。
这个键是红色的。那个键是蓝色的。
这里有一个黄色的键，那里有一个绿色的。
我点击按键，打出我的名字。多有趣呀！

lessons.title: Set a password
lessons.en:
Dad: Let's set a password for the tablet.
Emma: How many numbers do we need?
Dad: Pick four numbers, from one to ten.
Emma: My secret password is ready!
Dad: Good. Remember it, and keep it safe.
Emma: I'll type it carefully every time.
lessons.cn:
爸爸：我们来给平板设个密码吧。
艾玛：我们需要几个数字？
爸爸：选四个数字，从一到十。
艾玛：我的秘密密码好啦！
爸爸：很好。记住它，并且保管好。
艾玛：我每次都会小心地输入。

lessons.title: Keep it secret
lessons.en:
A password is a special secret.
It is made of numbers, like 2, 5, 8, 0.
We type the password to keep things safe.
Don't tell your password to others.
Remember it well, and you are safe!
lessons.cn:
密码是一个特别的秘密。
它由数字组成，比如 2、5、8、0。
我们输入密码来保证东西安全。
不要把你的密码告诉别人。
好好记住它，你就安全啦！

words.example: Draw a circle for the sun.

lessons.title: I can draw
lessons.en:
Lucy: Look, I can draw a picture!
Peter: What can you draw?
Lucy: I can draw a circle for the sun and a line for the road.
Peter: Can you paint it?
Lucy: Yes, I can. I paint the sun yellow.
Peter: Wow, it's a nice picture!
lessons.cn:
露西：看，我会画画！
彼得：你会画什么？
露西：我能画一个圆作太阳，画一条线作马路。
彼得：你能涂色吗？
露西：能。我把太阳涂成黄色。
彼得：哇，这是一幅漂亮的画！

lessons.title: My picture
lessons.en:
I like to draw with my pen.
First, I draw a circle. It is the sun.
Then I draw two lines. They are the road.
I paint the picture with red and green.
Now my picture is ready. It is so nice!
lessons.cn:
我喜欢用我的笔画画。
首先，我画一个圆。它是太阳。
然后我画两条线。它们是马路。
我用红色和绿色给画上色。
现在我的画好啦。它真漂亮！

lessons.title: Listen well
lessons.en:
Teacher: Class, please be quiet.
Jack: Sorry. I will listen now.
Teacher: Use your ears. Be a careful listener.
Jack: I can hear you well now.
Teacher: Good! A good listener learns a lot.
Jack: I want to be a good listener every day.
lessons.cn:
老师：同学们，请安静。
杰克：对不起。我现在就听。
老师：用你的耳朵。做一个仔细的倾听者。
杰克：我现在能听清楚您了。
老师：很好！好的倾听者学到很多。
杰克：我想每天都做个好的倾听者。

lessons.title: A good listener
lessons.en:
A good listener is quiet and careful.
We listen with our ears, not our mouths.
When a friend talks, we hear every word.
We say "please" and we wait for our turn.
Be a good listener, and you have more friends!
lessons.cn:
好的倾听者安静又仔细。
我们用耳朵听，而不是用嘴。
当朋友说话时，我们听清每一个字。
我们说"请"，并等待轮到自己。
做一个好的倾听者，你会有更多朋友！

lessons.title: Time to exercise
lessons.en:
Coach: It's time to exercise, everyone!
Nina: What can we do today?
Coach: We can run, jump and play ball.
Nina: Can we swim too?
Coach: Yes, on Friday. Sport makes us healthy.
Nina: I love exercise. Let's start!
lessons.cn:
教练：大家，该锻炼啦！
妮娜：我们今天能做什么？
教练：我们可以跑步、跳跃和打球。
妮娜：我们也能游泳吗？
教练：能，周五。运动让我们健康。
妮娜：我爱锻炼。我们开始吧！

lessons.title: Let's be healthy
lessons.en:
Exercise is good for us every day.
In the morning, I run and jump.
In summer, I like to swim.
After school, my friends and I play ball.
We do sports and stay healthy and happy!
lessons.cn:
锻炼每天都对我们有好处。
早上，我跑步和跳跃。
夏天，我喜欢游泳。
放学后，我和朋友们打球。
我们做运动，保持健康和快乐！

lessons.title: Our music show
lessons.en:
Miss Wang: Let's have a music show on the stage.
Tom: I can sing an English song.
Lily: I can dance with my friends.
Miss Wang: Who can read the letters and numbers?
Tom: I can! A, B, C and one, two, three!
Lily: What a happy music show!
lessons.cn:
王老师：我们在舞台上办一场音乐表演吧。
汤姆：我能唱一首英文歌。
莉莉：我能和朋友们一起跳舞。
王老师：谁能读字母和数字？
汤姆：我能！A、B、C 和一、二、三！
莉莉：多快乐的音乐表演呀！

lessons.title: We can do it!
lessons.en:
This term we learned so much.
We know letters, words, colours and numbers.
We can draw, listen, exercise and play.
Now we sing and dance in our music show.
Good friends, good music — what a nice show!
lessons.cn:
这个学期我们学了好多。
我们认识字母、单词、颜色和数字。
我们会画画、倾听、锻炼和玩耍。
现在我们在音乐表演里又唱又跳。
好朋友、好音乐——多棒的一场表演！

lessons.title: Time to get up
lessons.en:
Mum: Anna, it's seven o'clock. Get up!
Anna: OK, Mum. I'm tired.
Mum: Wash your face and brush your teeth.
Anna: I'm ready. What's for breakfast?
Mum: Milk and bread. Hurry up!
lessons.cn:
妈妈：安娜，七点了。起床！
安娜：好的，妈妈。我好困。
妈妈：洗脸刷牙。
安娜：我准备好了。早餐吃什么？
妈妈：牛奶和面包。快点！

lessons.title: My morning
lessons.en: I get up at seven every morning. First I wash my face. Then I brush my teeth. I eat breakfast with my family. We have eggs and milk. At seven thirty, I am ready for school. A new day begins!
lessons.cn: 每天早上我七点起床。我先洗脸，然后刷牙。我和家人一起吃早餐。我们吃鸡蛋和牛奶。七点半，我准备好上学了。新的一天开始啦！

words.example: Mum is busy in the kitchen.
I go to school by bus.

lessons.title: What a day!
lessons.en:
Ben: Hi, Anna! How was your day?
Anna: Great! We played games at school.
Ben: That sounds fun.
Anna: Yes, but I am very tired now.
Ben: Go home and have a rest!
lessons.cn:
本：嗨，安娜！今天过得怎么样？
安娜：好极了！我们在学校玩了游戏。
本：听起来很有趣。
安娜：是的，不过我现在好累。
本：那就回家休息一下吧！

lessons.title: A busy day
lessons.en: Today is a busy day. In the morning I went to school. I had four lessons. We sang songs and played games. After school I helped Mum at home. At night I read a book in bed. I am tired, but I am very happy. What a great day!
lessons.cn: 今天是忙碌的一天。早上我上学了。我上了四节课。我们唱歌、玩游戏。放学后我在家帮妈妈。晚上我在床上看了一本书。我很累，但是很开心。多么棒的一天啊！

lessons.title: My Saturday plan
lessons.en:
Anna: Look at my plan for Saturday!
Ben: Cool! What will you do first?
Anna: First I'll read a book. Then I'll play with my dog.
Ben: And next?
Anna: Next I'll finish my homework. After that, we can play together!
lessons.cn:
安娜：看我周六的计划！
本：酷！你首先要做什么？
安娜：我先读书，然后陪我的狗玩。
本：然后呢？
安娜：接下来我做完作业。之后我们就可以一起玩了！

lessons.title: A clock on the wall
lessons.en: There is a big clock on the wall. It tells me the time. At seven, I get up. At eight, I am at school. At twelve, it's time for lunch. At four, school is over. At seven in the evening, I finish my homework. Time goes fast — make a good plan every day!
lessons.cn: 墙上有一只大钟。它告诉我时间。七点起床。八点我在学校。十二点是午餐时间。四点放学。晚上七点我做完作业。时间过得真快——每天都要做个好计划！

lessons.title: Come to my party!
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, I have a party on Sunday. Come and join us!
Ben: Sure! What will we do?
Anna: We'll play games and sing songs together.
Ben: Sounds great! Can I bring a friend?
Anna: Of course! Welcome!
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我周日有个聚会。来加入我们吧！
本：当然！我们会做什么？
安娜：我们一起玩游戏、唱歌。
本：太棒了！我能带个朋友来吗？
安娜：当然！欢迎！

lessons.title: A happy party
lessons.en: On Sunday, my friends came to my home. We had a party. We played games and ate cakes. We sang songs together. Ben said, "Thank you, Anna. I'm so happy today." I am happy too. Friends make us smile!
lessons.cn: 周日，我的朋友们来我家了。我们办了个聚会。我们玩游戏、吃蛋糕。我们一起唱歌。本说："谢谢你，安娜，我今天好开心。"我也很开心。朋友让我们露出笑容！

lessons.title: Our classroom
lessons.en:
Ben: Look at our new classroom!
Anna: Wow, it's so clean and tidy.
Ben: There is a big poster on the wall.
Anna: It says, "Be kind, be brave!" That's our class call.
Ben: I love our classroom!
lessons.cn:
本：看我们的新教室！
安娜：哇，又干净又整洁。
本：墙上有一张大海报。
安娜：上面写着"善良、勇敢"，那是我们班的口号。
本：我喜欢我们的教室！

lessons.title: Our class rules
lessons.en: Our classroom is small but warm. Each desk and chair has a name on it. We have three class rules: keep clean, keep tidy, and help each other. Our class call is "One team, one dream!" We say it loudly every morning. We love our class!
lessons.cn: 我们的教室不大但很温暖。每张课桌椅上都有名字。我们有三条班规：保持干净、保持整洁、互相帮助。我们的班级口号是"一个团队，一个梦想！"每天早上我们都大声喊出它。我们爱我们的班级！

lessons.title: I'm on duty today
lessons.en:
Anna: I'm on duty today. What should I do?
Ben: First, sweep the floor.
Anna: OK. Then?
Ben: Then wipe the windows and water the plants.
Anna: Thanks, Ben. I will do my best!
lessons.cn:
安娜：我今天值日。我要做什么？
本：首先，扫地。
安娜：好的。然后呢？
本：然后擦窗户、给植物浇水。
安娜：谢谢，本，我会尽力做好！

lessons.title: A duty day
lessons.en: Today is my duty day. After class, I sweep the floor and wipe the desks. Ben helps me clean the windows. The little plants by the window look thirsty, so I water them. Now our classroom is clean and bright. I feel tired but very happy. Helping others is fun!
lessons.cn: 今天是我的值日日。下课后，我扫地、擦课桌。本帮我擦窗户。窗边的小植物看起来口渴了，所以我给它们浇水。现在我们的教室又干净又明亮。我感到很累但很开心。帮助别人真有趣！

lessons.title: Don't run in the hall
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, don't run in the hall!
Ben: Sorry, Anna. I'm late for class.
Anna: You should walk, not run. It's safer.
Ben: You're right. Thanks for telling me.
Anna: We should follow the school rules.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，不要在走廊里跑！
本：对不起，安娜。我上课要迟到了。
安娜：你应该走，不是跑，这样更安全。
本：你说得对，谢谢提醒。
安娜：我们应该遵守校规。

lessons.title: Our school rules
lessons.en: Our school has some easy rules. Don't run in the hall. Don't shout in class. We should walk slowly and speak quietly. We should be kind to friends and listen to teachers. Rules keep us safe and happy. A good school is everyone's home!
lessons.cn: 我们学校有一些简单的规则。不要在走廊里跑。不要在课堂上大喊。我们应该慢慢走，小声说话。我们应该对朋友友好，听老师的话。规则让我们安全又快乐。好学校是大家的家！

words.example: Excuse me, may I come in?

lessons.title: A polite way
lessons.en:
Ben: Excuse me, may I borrow your pen?
Anna: Sure, here you are.
Ben: Thanks a lot, Anna.
Anna: You're welcome. 
Ben: Sorry, I forgot to greet you this morning.
Anna: That's OK. A smile makes everyone happy.
lessons.cn:
本：打扰一下，我能借你的笔吗？
安娜：当然，给你。
本：非常感谢，安娜。
安娜：不客气。
本：抱歉，我今天早上忘了向你问好。
安娜：没关系。一个微笑能让大家都开心。

lessons.title: Magic words
lessons.en: "Please", "thanks", and "sorry" are magic words. When we want something, we say "please". When others help us, we say "thanks". When we make a mistake, we say "sorry". A kind smile and a polite word can warm a cold day. Be polite, and you will have many friends!
lessons.cn: "请"、"谢谢"和"对不起"是魔法词。我们想要东西时说"请"。别人帮我们时说"谢谢"。我们犯错时说"对不起"。一个友善的微笑和一句礼貌的话能温暖寒冷的一天。做个有礼貌的人，你会有很多朋友！

lessons.title: Road Helper Day
lessons.en:
Anna: Today is Road Helper Day! I am a little helper.
Ben: What do you do?
Anna: I help kids cross the road. Red light, stop. Green light, go.
Ben: That's great! Can I join you?
Anna: Sure! Always be safe on the road.
lessons.cn:
安娜：今天是交通小帮手日！我是小帮手。
本：你要做什么？
安娜：我帮小朋友过马路。红灯停，绿灯行。
本：太棒了！我能加入吗？
安娜：当然！过马路一定要注意安全。

lessons.title: Be safe on the road
lessons.en: Every Friday is our Road Helper Day. We stand by the road in front of the school. When the light is red, we tell people, "Stop and wait." When the light is green, we say, "Now you can go." Kids smile and say "Thanks." Being kind and helpful is a great way to start a new day!
lessons.cn: 每周五是我们的交通小帮手日。我们站在学校前面的马路边。红灯时我们告诉大家："停下来等等"。绿灯时我们说："现在可以走啦"。小朋友们微笑着说"谢谢"。乐于助人是开启新一天的好方式！

words.example: We watch TV in the living room.

lessons.title: Welcome to my home
lessons.en:
Anna: Hi, Ben! Welcome to my home.
Ben: Wow, what a beautiful house!
Anna: Come in, please. This is our living room.
Ben: It's so big! Is that the kitchen?
Anna: Yes. Let me show you my bedroom upstairs.
lessons.cn:
安娜：嗨，本！欢迎来我家。
本：哇，多漂亮的房子！
安娜：请进。这是我们的客厅。
本：好大啊！那是厨房吗？
安娜：是的。我带你看看楼上的卧室。

lessons.title: My new home
lessons.en: I have a new home. It is small but very beautiful. There is a soft sofa in the living room. The kitchen is white and clean. My bedroom has a small bed and a desk. I like to read books here. Welcome to my home — come in and have a look!
lessons.cn: 我有一个新家。它不大但很漂亮。客厅里有一张柔软的沙发。厨房又白又干净。我的卧室里有一张小床和一张书桌。我喜欢在这里看书。欢迎来我家——快进来看看吧！

lessons.title: Meet my family
lessons.en:
Anna: Look, Ben. This is my family photo.
Ben: Who is the man with glasses?
Anna: He's my father. The kind lady is my mother.
Ben: And the little boy?
Anna: That's my brother. Grandpa and Grandma live with us, too.
lessons.cn:
安娜：看，本。这是我的家庭照。
本：戴眼镜的男人是谁？
安娜：他是我父亲，旁边温柔的女士是我母亲。
本：那小男孩呢？
安娜：是我弟弟。爷爷奶奶也和我们住在一起。

lessons.title: A loving family
lessons.en: There are six people in my family. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. Grandpa and Grandma live with us, too. After dinner, we sit together and talk. We love each other very much. A loving family is the best gift!
lessons.cn: 我家有六口人。爸爸是医生。妈妈是老师。我有一个弟弟和一个妹妹。爷爷奶奶也和我们住在一起。晚饭后我们一起聊天。我们彼此非常相爱。有爱的家庭就是最棒的礼物！

words.example: Wash your hands in the bathroom.
Put the cup on the table.

lessons.title: Show me your house
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, can you show me your house?
Anna: Sure! This is the kitchen, and that is the study.
Ben: Where is your bedroom?
Anna: It's upstairs. Come and see.
Ben: Wow, you have a small garden too!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，能带我参观你家吗？
安娜：当然！这是厨房，那是书房。
本：你的卧室在哪？
安娜：在楼上。来看看吧。
本：哇，你还有个小花园！

lessons.title: My favourite room
lessons.en: My favourite room is my bedroom. It is upstairs near the bathroom. There is a small bed, a desk and a lamp. I do my homework at the desk. At night, my lamp is bright and warm. I read storybooks in bed until Mum says, "Time to sleep!"
lessons.cn: 我最喜欢的房间是卧室。它在楼上，挨着浴室。屋里有一张小床、一张书桌和一盏灯。我在桌前做作业。夜里灯光又亮又温暖。我在床上看故事书，直到妈妈说"该睡觉啦！"

words.example: What do you do at school?

lessons.title: What do you do at home?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, what do you do at home?
Anna: I read books and draw pictures.
Ben: Do you watch TV?
Anna: Yes, but only on weekends.
Ben: I write a diary every day. It's fun!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你在家做什么？
安娜：我看书、画画。
本：你看电视吗？
安娜：看，但只在周末。
本：我每天写日记，很有趣！

lessons.title: My daily things
lessons.en: Every day I do many things. In the morning, I go to school and study with my friends. After school, I do my homework at the study desk. Then I read a story or draw a picture. After dinner, I watch a short TV show with my family. A full day, a happy day!
lessons.cn: 我每天做很多事。早上我去上学，和朋友一起学习。放学后我在书桌前做作业。然后看一个故事或画一幅画。晚饭后和家人一起看会儿电视。充实的一天，快乐的一天！

lessons.title: What's your hobby?
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, what's your hobby?
Ben: My hobby is music. I play the piano.
Anna: Cool! I love dance. I can also swim.
Ben: My sister can cook many things — that's her hobby.
Anna: Hobbies make us happy!
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，你的爱好是什么？
本：我的爱好是音乐，我弹钢琴。
安娜：酷！我喜欢跳舞，还会游泳。
本：我姐姐会做很多菜，那是她的爱好。
安娜：爱好让我们快乐！

lessons.title: Hobbies in my class
lessons.en: Everyone in my class has a hobby. Tom plays the guitar. Lily likes to dance. Ben plays the piano very well. Anna loves swimming. I like cooking with Mum at weekends. My favourite hobby is reading storybooks. A hobby is like a good friend — it stays with you for life!
lessons.cn: 我们班每个同学都有爱好。汤姆弹吉他。莉莉喜欢跳舞。本钢琴弹得很好。安娜喜欢游泳。周末我喜欢和妈妈一起做饭。我最爱的爱好是看故事书。爱好就像好朋友，一辈子陪着你！

words.example: The cat is on the chair.

lessons.title: At the zoo
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, look at the pandas! They're so cute.
Anna: I love their black and white fur.
Ben: There are many animals here — birds, rabbits and even a tiger.
Anna: My favourite is the little fish in the pond.
Ben: The zoo is full of fun!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，看那些熊猫！它们好可爱。
安娜：我喜欢它们黑白相间的毛。
本：这里好多动物——鸟、兔子，还有老虎呢。
安娜：我最喜欢池塘里的小鱼。
本：动物园真有趣！

lessons.title: My favourite animal
lessons.en: My favourite animal is the panda. Pandas live in the mountains of China. They are black and white. They eat bamboo all day. Pandas look slow but they can climb trees very fast. I want to see a real panda one day. Animals are our friends — let's protect them!
lessons.cn: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。熊猫生活在中国的山里。它们黑白相间。它们整天吃竹子。熊猫看起来慢，但它们能很快爬上树。有一天我想看到真正的熊猫。动物是我们的朋友——让我们保护它们！

lessons.title: Plans for the weekend
lessons.en:
Ben: What will you do this weekend, Anna?
Anna: On Saturday, my family will have a picnic in the park.
Ben: Sounds great! What about Sunday?
Anna: Mum and I will shop in the morning, then see a movie.
Ben: Have a happy weekend!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，这周末你要做什么？
安娜：周六我们一家要去公园野餐。
本：好棒！周日呢？
安娜：上午我和妈妈购物，然后去看电影。
本：周末愉快！

lessons.title: My happy weekend
lessons.en: I love weekends. On Saturday, I usually visit the park with my family. We bring sandwiches and have a picnic on the grass. On Sunday morning, I do my homework. In the afternoon, my friends and I see a fun movie. Weekends are short, but they are full of fun and love!
lessons.cn: 我喜欢周末。周六我通常和家人去公园。我们带上三明治，在草地上野餐。周日上午做作业。下午和朋友看部有趣的电影。周末很短，但充满了快乐和爱！

words.example: Here is a gift for you.
I send a card to her.

lessons.title: A merry Christmas
lessons.en:
Ben: Merry Christmas, Anna!
Anna: Merry Christmas, Ben! Look at our Christmas tree.
Ben: Wow, so many gifts under it!
Anna: I made a card for Mum and Dad.
Ben: How sweet! Let's enjoy the big dinner tonight.
lessons.cn:
本：圣诞快乐，安娜！
安娜：圣诞快乐，本！看我们的圣诞树。
本：哇，树下好多礼物！
安娜：我给爸妈做了张卡片。
本：好暖心！我们今晚好好享受这顿大餐吧。

lessons.title: Festivals in my family
lessons.en: My family loves festivals. At Spring Festival, we eat dumplings and visit our grandparents. We get red envelopes — that's so much fun. At Christmas, we put up a tree and sing songs. We make cards for friends. Festivals bring our family closer. They make every year warm and bright!
lessons.cn: 我家喜欢节日。春节时我们吃饺子，去看爷爷奶奶。我们收到红包——很有趣。圣诞节时我们装饰圣诞树、唱歌。我们为朋友做卡片。节日让我们一家更亲近。它们让每一年都温暖又明亮！

lessons.title: Happy New Year!
lessons.en:
Ben: Happy New Year, Anna!
Anna: Happy New Year, Ben! Best wishes to you and your family.
Ben: Thank you. What are your wishes this year?
Anna: I wish to learn more English and make new friends.
Ben: Me too! Let's share a smile and start the new year together.
lessons.cn:
本：新年快乐，安娜！
安娜：新年快乐，本！祝你和家人一切顺利。
本：谢谢。你今年的愿望是什么？
安娜：我希望学更多英语、交新朋友。
本：我也是！让我们带着笑容一起开启新年。

lessons.title: A new year, new me
lessons.en: A new year has come! I have many new wishes. I wish to study hard and read more storybooks. I wish to help Mum at home and share with my friends. Most of all, I wish my family and all my friends a year full of smiles. Happy New Year, everyone!
lessons.cn: 新的一年到了！我有很多新愿望。我希望努力学习、多读故事书。希望在家帮妈妈、和朋友们分享。最重要的，我祝家人和所有朋友新的一年充满微笑。大家新年快乐！

words.example: A bird is in the tree.

lessons.title: Spring is here
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, look! The trees are green again.
Ben: Yes! Spring is here. It's so warm.
Anna: Many flowers are blooming on the grass.
Ben: Let's fly a kite in the wind.
Anna: Great idea! I love spring.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，看！树又绿了。
本：是的！春天来了，好暖和。
安娜：草地上开了很多花。
本：我们去放风筝吧。
安娜：好主意！我爱春天。

lessons.title: A warm day
lessons.en: It is a warm spring day. The sun is bright and the wind is soft. Pink and yellow flowers grow on the green grass. Birds sing in the tall trees. After a short rain, a small rainbow appears in the sky. Spring is the most lovely time of the year.
lessons.cn: 这是一个温暖的春日。阳光明媚，微风轻柔。粉色和黄色的花开在绿草上。鸟儿在高树上唱歌。一阵小雨后，天上出现了一道小彩虹。春天是一年中最美的时节。

lessons.title: What do I wear?
lessons.en:
Anna: What will you wear to the party, Ben?
Ben: I'll wear a white shirt and blue trousers.
Anna: Cool! I want to wear my pink skirt.
Ben: Don't forget your hat — the sun is strong.
Anna: OK! Let's go.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，你穿什么去聚会？
本：白衬衫蓝裤子。
安娜：酷！我想穿粉色裙子。
本：别忘戴帽子，太阳大。
安娜：好，走吧！

lessons.title: My favourite clothes
lessons.en: I have many clothes in my closet. I wear T-shirts and shorts in summer. In spring, I like a light shirt and a pair of jeans. New shoes are always exciting. On rainy days, Mum tells me to wear my yellow boots. Clothes keep us warm and make us smile.
lessons.cn: 我衣柜里有很多衣服。夏天我穿 T 恤和短裤。春天我喜欢穿轻便衬衫和牛仔裤。新鞋总是让人兴奋。下雨天妈妈让我穿黄色雨靴。衣服让我们温暖，也让我们开心。

lessons.title: How much is it?
lessons.en:
Anna: Mum, look at this red T-shirt. It's so nice.
Mum: How much is it?
Anna: It's only twenty yuan. Quite cheap!
Mum: OK, we can buy it. Look, that one is fifty yuan — too expensive.
Anna: Let's pay and go.
lessons.cn:
安娜：妈妈，看这件红 T 恤，真好看。
妈妈：多少钱？
安娜：才二十元，很便宜！
妈妈：好，我们买。看那件五十元，太贵了。
安娜：付钱走吧。

lessons.title: Shopping with Mum
lessons.en: On Saturday, Mum and I went to a big store. We needed some new clothes. We saw many shirts and shoes. The blue T-shirt was only twenty yuan, but the white shoes cost two hundred yuan. We bought a few cheap things and saved some money. Shopping with Mum is always fun.
lessons.cn: 周六我和妈妈去了一家大商店。我们要买些新衣服。看到了很多衬衫和鞋子。蓝 T 恤才 20 元，但白鞋要 200 元。我们买了几样便宜的，省了一些钱。和妈妈购物总是很开心。

lessons.title: How much in total?
lessons.en:
Anna: I want to buy a book and a pen.
Shopkeeper: The book is thirty yuan, the pen is twenty yuan.
Anna: How much in total?
Shopkeeper: Fifty yuan, please.
Anna: Here you are. Thank you.
lessons.cn:
安娜：我想买一本书和一支笔。
店主：书 30 元，笔 20 元。
安娜：一共多少钱？
店主：50 元。
安娜：给您。谢谢。

lessons.title: Count and pay
lessons.en: Numbers help us in many ways. We count money, count days, and count the steps we walk. At the store, we add up the prices to know the total. Twenty plus thirty makes fifty. A hundred yuan can buy quite a few things. Learn the numbers, and you can pay by yourself!
lessons.cn: 数字在很多方面帮助我们。我们数钱、数日子、数走过的步数。在商店里，我们把价格加起来算出总数。20 加 30 等于 50。一百块钱能买不少东西。学会数字，你就能自己付钱了！

lessons.title: What's your favourite?
lessons.en:
Ben: What's your favourite food, Anna?
Anna: I love noodles and dumplings.
Ben: I prefer rice and meat.
Anna: Vegetables are also important. Mum says they make us strong.
Ben: True! Let's eat more healthy food.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你最爱什么吃的？
安娜：我喜欢面条和饺子。
本：我更喜欢米饭和肉。
安娜：蔬菜也很重要，妈妈说能让我们强壮。
本：对！我们要多吃健康食物。

lessons.title: A tasty meal
lessons.en: My grandma is a great cook. She makes tasty rice, soft noodles, and warm bread. Her vegetable soup is famous in our family. After a meal, she gives us a small sweet — fruit or cake. Eating together with family makes every meal more delicious.
lessons.cn: 我奶奶做菜很厉害。她做香喷喷的米饭、软软的面条和暖暖的面包。她做的蔬菜汤在我们家很有名。饭后她还会给我们点小甜品——水果或蛋糕。和家人一起吃饭让每顿饭更美味。

lessons.title: Help Mum cook
lessons.en:
Mum: Anna, will you help me in the kitchen?
Anna: Sure, Mum. What can I do?
Mum: Please wash the fruit and break two eggs.
Anna: OK. Where is the spoon?
Mum: Beside the knife and fork. Thanks, dear!
lessons.cn:
妈妈：安娜，能在厨房帮我吗？
安娜：好的，妈妈。我能做什么？
妈妈：请洗一下水果，再打两个鸡蛋。
安娜：好。勺子在哪？
妈妈：在刀叉旁边。谢谢宝贝！

lessons.title: A small chef
lessons.en: Today I am a small chef. First, I wash my hands and put on an apron. Then I break two eggs into a bowl and add some milk. Mum lets me cut the bread with a small knife. The kitchen smells warm and sweet. Cooking is a wonderful skill to learn!
lessons.cn: 今天我是小厨师。首先洗手戴围裙。然后打两个鸡蛋到碗里加点牛奶。妈妈让我用小刀切面包。厨房闻起来又暖又香。烹饪是一项很棒的技能！

lessons.title: Good habits
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, why are you so strong?
Anna: I have healthy habits. I exercise every morning.
Ben: What else do you do?
Anna: I eat fresh fruit, drink lots of water and sleep early.
Ben: I should learn from you!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你怎么这么强壮？
安娜：我有健康习惯。每天早晨锻炼。
本：还有呢？
安娜：吃新鲜水果，多喝水，早睡。
本：我得向你学习！

lessons.title: A healthy day
lessons.en: A healthy day starts with a good breakfast. We should drink water and eat fresh fruit. Sweets are tasty but we shouldn't eat too many. After school, ride a bike or play sports. At night, sleep early so we can wake up fresh. Good habits make us strong and happy.
lessons.cn: 健康的一天从好早餐开始。我们应该喝水、吃新鲜水果。糖果好吃但不能吃太多。放学后骑车或运动。晚上早睡，第二天才有精神。好习惯让我们强壮又快乐。

lessons.title: By the lake
lessons.en:
Anna: It's a sunny Saturday! Let's have a picnic.
Ben: Great! I'll bring sandwiches and juice.
Anna: I have a big basket. We can sit by the lake.
Ben: Let's invite Tom and Lily to share with us.
Anna: Yes, the more, the merrier!
lessons.cn:
安娜：阳光明媚的周六，我们去野餐吧！
本：好！我带三明治和果汁。
安娜：我有个大篮子，我们可以坐在湖边。
本：叫上汤姆和莉莉一起。
安娜：好，人越多越热闹！

lessons.title: Picnic by the lake
lessons.en: Last Sunday we had a wonderful picnic by the lake. The sun was warm and the water was blue. We put a big mat on the grass and opened our baskets. There were sandwiches, fruit, juice and cookies. We shared everything and laughed a lot. A picnic with friends is the best part of spring.
lessons.cn: 上周日我们在湖边野餐，玩得很开心。阳光暖暖，湖水蓝蓝。我们在草地上铺好大垫子，打开篮子。里面有三明治、水果、果汁和饼干。我们彼此分享，笑个不停。和朋友野餐是春天最棒的事。

lessons.title: A lovely spring
lessons.en:
Anna: This spring is so lovely. We did so many fun things!
Ben: We flew kites, had a picnic and went shopping.
Anna: I want to write all of this in my diary.
Ben: Don't forget to thank our friends.
Anna: Sure. Friends make every season better.
lessons.cn:
安娜：今年春天太美好了，我们做了好多有趣的事！
本：放风筝、野餐、购物。
安娜：我要把这些都写到日记里。
本：别忘了谢谢朋友们。
安娜：当然，有朋友每个季节都更美好。

lessons.title: My spring diary
lessons.en: Spring is almost over. In my diary I wrote about every weekend. We flew kites in the park, learned to cook with Mum, and had a picnic by the lake. I remember the warm sun, the green grass and my friends' smiles. Thank you, lovely spring — I will miss you.
lessons.cn: 春天快结束了。日记里写满了每个周末。我们去公园放风筝、和妈妈学做饭、在湖边野餐。我记得暖暖的太阳、绿绿的草和朋友们的笑容。谢谢你，美好的春天——我会想你。

words.example: I hope to learn a lot.

lessons.title: Welcome back
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, welcome back! How was your summer?
Anna: Great! I'm so excited for the new school year.
Ben: We are in Grade 5 now. New classmates, new teachers!
Anna: Let's introduce ourselves to the new students.
Ben: Sure. I hope this term will be exciting.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，欢迎回来！暑假怎么样？
安娜：很棒！我对新学年好激动。
本：我们现在五年级了，新同学新老师！
安娜：我们去给新同学介绍自己吧。
本：好。希望这学期会很精彩。

lessons.title: My fifth-grade plan
lessons.en: I am in Grade 5 this year. The new schedule on the wall has many subjects: English, Maths, music and PE. I hope to make new friends and learn many new things. My biggest hope is to read fifty English books before the term ends. A new year, a new me!
lessons.cn: 今年我五年级。墙上的新课表有很多课：英语、数学、音乐、体育。我希望交新朋友，学很多新东西。我最大的愿望是这学期结束前读完五十本英文书。新的一年，新的我！

lessons.title: What's your favourite?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, what's your favourite subject?
Anna: I love English and art. They are easy for me.
Ben: I like science and PE. Maths is a little difficult.
Anna: Don't worry. We can study together.
Ben: Thanks, Anna. You are a great friend!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你最喜欢什么科目？
安娜：英语和美术，对我很容易。
本：我喜欢科学和体育。数学有点难。
安娜：别担心，我们一起学。
本：谢谢安娜，你真好！

lessons.title: Subjects in Grade 5
lessons.en: Grade 5 has many subjects. English helps us talk with people from other countries. Maths trains our minds to think. Science shows us how the world works. Art and music make us creative. PE keeps our bodies strong. Every subject is a small door to a bigger world.
lessons.cn: 五年级有很多科目。英语帮我们与外国人交流。数学训练我们思考。科学让我们了解世界如何运作。美术和音乐让我们更有创造力。体育让我们身体强壮。每门课都是通往更大世界的一扇小门。

lessons.title: Show your talent
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, what's your talent?
Anna: I can sing songs in English. What about you?
Ben: I can speak three languages and tell stories.
Anna: Wow, cool! Let's show our talents on the school stage.
Ben: Yes! I'm sure our parents will be proud.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你有什么才艺？
安娜：我会用英语唱歌，你呢？
本：我会说三种语言，还会讲故事。
安娜：哇酷！我们去学校舞台上展示吧。
本：好！爸妈一定会自豪的。

lessons.title: Everyone has a talent
lessons.en: Everyone has at least one talent. Some children sing or dance well. Others can draw beautiful pictures. My friend Tom can speak in front of three hundred people without fear. My classmate Lily writes funny stories. Find your talent, share it on the stage, and your family will be proud of you.
lessons.cn: 每个人都有至少一项才能。有的孩子唱歌跳舞好。有的能画漂亮的画。我的朋友汤姆能在三百人面前演讲不害怕。同学莉莉能写有趣的故事。找到你的才能，登上舞台展示，家人会为你骄傲。

lessons.title: At the library
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, I want to borrow a story book. Where is it?
Ben: It's on the shelf by the window. Show your card.
Anna: Thanks. The library is so quiet.
Ben: Remember to return it within two weeks.
Anna: Sure, I'll read a few pages every night.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我想借一本故事书，在哪里？
本：在窗边的书架上。出示借书卡。
安娜：谢谢，图书馆好安静。
本：记得两周内还。
安娜：好，每天晚上看几页。

lessons.title: The school library
lessons.en: Our school library has thousands of books and magazines. Students can borrow up to three books with their library card. The library is always quiet — we should not shout or run. Mrs Lee, the librarian, is very kind. She helps us find the right book in just a minute. The library is the heart of our school.
lessons.cn: 我们学校的图书馆有上千本书和杂志。学生凭借书卡最多借三本。图书馆总是很安静——我们不能喊叫或奔跑。李老师是图书管理员，非常和蔼，一分钟就能帮我们找到合适的书。图书馆是学校的心脏。

lessons.title: Cheer for our team
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, today is our Sports Day. Are you ready?
Anna: Yes! I'll run the 100-meter race.
Ben: Cool! I'll join the long jump.
Anna: Whether we win or lose, let's cheer for our team!
Ben: Right! Together we are strong.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，今天是运动会，你准备好了吗？
安娜：好了！我跑 100 米。
本：酷！我参加跳远。
安娜：不管输赢，我们都为队加油！
本：对！团结就是力量。

lessons.title: A wonderful Sports Day
lessons.en: Today was our school's Sports Day. The playground was full of cheering students. I joined the relay race and helped my team win second place. Ben threw a small ball very far. Even when some friends lost, they smiled and tried again. Sports teach us teamwork and never giving up.
lessons.cn: 今天是学校运动会。操场上同学们都在加油。我参加接力赛，帮队伍拿到第二名。本扔小球扔得很远。即使有同学输了，他们也笑着再试。运动教会我们团队合作，永不放弃。

lessons.title: Festivals we love
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, what festivals do you celebrate?
Ben: I love Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn. We eat moon cakes.
Anna: In the West, kids celebrate Halloween — they wear masks.
Ben: My pen pal in the US loves Thanksgiving.
Anna: Festivals show different traditions around the world.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，你过哪些节？
本：我喜欢春节和中秋节，吃月饼。
安娜：西方孩子过万圣节，戴面具。
本：我美国笔友最爱感恩节。
安娜：节日展示了世界各地的不同传统。

lessons.title: One world, many festivals
lessons.en: Festivals are different around the world. In China, families gather for Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival. In the United States, people enjoy Thanksgiving dinner with turkey. In Mexico, children break colourful piñatas at parties. Each tradition is special. Festivals remind us that we are one big family on this planet.
lessons.cn: 世界各地的节日各不相同。在中国，家人一起过春节和中秋。在美国，人们享用感恩节火鸡晚餐。在墨西哥，孩子们在派对上敲彩色皮纳塔。每个传统都很特别。节日提醒我们：地球上的我们是一个大家庭。

lessons.title: Which club?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, which school club will you join this year?
Anna: I want to join the photo club. I love taking pictures.
Ben: I'll join the robot club. We will build a small robot.
Anna: My sister joined the chess club last year.
Ben: Clubs help us find our true interests.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，今年你想加入哪个社团？
安娜：摄影社，我喜欢拍照。
本：我加机器人社，我们要造小机器人。
安娜：我姐姐去年加了国际象棋社。
本：社团帮我们找到真正的兴趣。

lessons.title: Our school clubs
lessons.en: Our school has many wonderful clubs. The drama club meets every Tuesday after school. The photo club takes a class trip every month to capture city life. The robot club builds small machines that move and talk. The chess club teaches careful thinking. Find a club you love and meet new friends — clubs make school life rich and colourful.
lessons.cn: 我们学校有很多社团。戏剧社每周二放学后活动。摄影社每月外出一次，记录城市生活。机器人社制作能动会说话的小机器。国际象棋社教我们仔细思考。找到喜欢的社团，结识新朋友——社团让校园生活丰富多彩。

lessons.title: A helping hand
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, the elderly man next door looks sad today.
Ben: Let's help him. We can carry his bags.
Anna: Good idea. A small kind act makes the world warmer.
Ben: My mum says, "A smile is the shortest helping hand."
Anna: True! Let's be kind volunteers in our neighbourhood.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，隔壁老爷爷今天看上去很难过。
本：我们去帮他，可以提袋子。
安娜：好。一件小小善举让世界更温暖。
本：妈妈说"微笑是最短的援手"。
安娜：对！我们做社区的好志愿者吧。

lessons.title: Small acts, big love
lessons.en: Last weekend, our class volunteered at the city park. We picked up rubbish, planted flowers, and helped elderly people walk to the bus stop. Some kids shared bread and warm drinks with strangers. A grandma even taught us how to fold paper birds. Small acts of kindness can build a great world. Be a helping hand every day!
lessons.cn: 上周末我们班在城市公园做志愿者。我们捡垃圾、种花、扶老人到公交站。有同学把面包和热饮分给陌生人。一位奶奶还教我们叠纸鸟。小小的善举能建设大世界。每天都做一只援手吧！

lessons.title: Time to shine
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, our school show is tomorrow! Are you ready?
Ben: Yes, I've prepared for weeks. I'll sing and act.
Anna: I'll join the drama club piece.
Ben: The audience will love it. Don't forget to smile!
Anna: We'll remember this show for a long time.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，明天就学校汇演了！你准备好了吗？
本：好了，我准备好几周了，要唱要演。
安娜：我加戏剧社的节目。
本：观众一定喜欢，别忘了笑。
安娜：这场演出我们会记很久。

lessons.title: A show to remember
lessons.en: Last Friday our school had a big Show Time. Each class prepared one act. We sang songs in English, danced to popular music, and even put on a short play about friendship. When the audience clapped after our performance, my heart jumped with joy. I will remember this show for many years. A new school year, a great new start!
lessons.cn: 上周五我们学校举办了大型汇演。每个班准备一个节目。我们唱英文歌、跳流行舞，甚至演了一出关于友谊的小话剧。表演结束观众鼓掌时，我心里乐开了花。这场演出我会记很多年。新学年，新开始！

lessons.title: Where shall we go?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, summer holiday is coming! Where shall we go?
Anna: How about the beach? We can swim and play in the sand.
Ben: Or we can climb the mountain — the view is amazing.
Anna: Let's discuss with our parents tonight.
Ben: Great idea! I love planning a trip.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，暑假快到了！我们去哪儿？
安娜：去海滩吧？可以游泳玩沙。
本：或者爬山——风景超美。
安娜：晚上和爸妈商量一下。
本：好主意！我喜欢计划旅行。

lessons.title: Making a plan
lessons.en: Planning a trip is part of the fun. First, we choose a place — the beach, a mountain, or a busy city. Then we pack clothes, water and snacks. We also write down the things we want to see. A good plan gives us more time to enjoy. After all, the best trips begin with a good idea!
lessons.cn: 计划旅行也是乐趣的一部分。首先选地方——海滩、山或繁华城市。然后打包衣服、水和零食。再写下想看的东西。好计划让我们有更多时间享受。毕竟最好的旅行始于一个好主意！

lessons.title: By plane or by train?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, how shall we go to Beijing?
Anna: By plane is fast, but the train is more interesting.
Ben: I agree. We can see the fields and rivers from the train window.
Anna: Tickets are also cheaper.
Ben: Then let's buy two train tickets tomorrow.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，我们怎么去北京？
安娜：坐飞机快，但火车更有趣。
本：同意，火车窗外能看到田野和河流。
安娜：车票也更便宜。
本：那明天买两张火车票。

lessons.title: Ways to travel
lessons.en: There are many ways to travel. Planes are the fastest. Trains take longer but show us beautiful scenery. In a city, we use the subway and the bus. For short trips around the neighbourhood, a bike is perfect. Each way has its own fun. The best part of travel is the journey itself.
lessons.cn: 出行方式有很多。飞机最快。火车较慢但能看到美丽风景。在城市里我们坐地铁和公交。短距离骑自行车正好。每种方式都有乐趣。旅行最棒的部分是旅程本身。

lessons.title: Excuse me, where is...?
lessons.en:
Tourist: Excuse me, can you show me the way to the museum?
Anna: Sure. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the crossroads.
Tourist: Is it on the right?
Anna: Yes, you can't miss it. There is a big sign.
Tourist: Thank you so much!
lessons.cn:
游客：打扰一下，请问博物馆怎么走？
安娜：直走两个街区，到十字路口左转。
游客：在右边吗？
安娜：对，错不了，有个大招牌。
游客：太感谢了！

lessons.title: Reading the map
lessons.en: When we travel, knowing how to ask the way is very useful. We can also read a map on our phone. If you turn left and then right, you may reach the small park. If you go straight, you may find the train station. Even if you get lost, kind people will help you find the way. Don't be afraid to ask!
lessons.cn: 旅行时会问路非常有用。也可以看手机地图。先左转再右转可能到小公园。一直直走能到火车站。即使迷路，好心人会帮你找路。别怕开口问！

lessons.title: Where will you go?
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, which tourist spot do you want to see most?
Anna: I want to visit the Great Wall and the Forbidden City.
Ben: Cool! I want to see a science museum in Shanghai.
Anna: There are so many famous spots in our country.
Ben: A trip is the best way to learn about a city.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你最想去哪个景点？
安娜：长城和故宫。
本：酷！我想去上海的科技馆。
安娜：我们国家有那么多名胜。
本：旅行是了解一座城市最好的方式。

lessons.title: Famous spots in China
lessons.en: China has many famous tourist spots. The Great Wall is over two thousand years old. The Forbidden City in Beijing has more than nine thousand rooms. In Xi'an, you can see the amazing Terracotta Army. In Shanghai, the modern science museum surprises every visitor. Every city has its own special place — go and explore them all!
lessons.cn: 中国有很多著名景点。长城已有两千多年历史。北京故宫有九千多间房。在西安能看到神奇的兵马俑。上海现代科技馆让每个游客惊叹。每座城市都有自己的特别之处——去探索吧！

lessons.title: At the gift shop
lessons.en:
Anna: This silk scarf is so beautiful! What colour do you prefer?
Ben: I'll take the red one. May I try on this hat too?
Shopkeeper: Sure. The size looks perfect.
Ben: How much is everything?
Shopkeeper: Two hundred yuan. Here is your receipt.
lessons.cn:
安娜：这条丝巾真漂亮！你喜欢什么颜色？
本：我要红色。也可以试戴这顶帽子吗？
店主：当然，尺寸正好。
本：一共多少钱？
店主：两百元，这是您的收据。

lessons.title: A good souvenir
lessons.en: A souvenir is a small gift that helps us remember a trip. When I went to Hangzhou, I bought a paper fan with a flower picture. When Dad went to Yunnan, he brought back a small silver hat for me. Choose a souvenir you really like — its size, colour and meaning all matter. Years later, it will still remind you of a happy day.
lessons.cn: 纪念品是帮我们记住旅行的小礼物。我去杭州买了一把画花的纸扇。爸爸从云南带回一顶小银帽给我。挑你真正喜欢的纪念品——尺寸、颜色、意义都重要。多年后它仍能让你想起开心的日子。

lessons.title: A postcard from Beijing
lessons.en:
Anna: Look, Ben! I got a postcard from Beijing.
Ben: Wow, who sent it?
Anna: My cousin Tom. He says the weather is sunny and the food is great.
Ben: There is a pretty stamp on it.
Anna: I'll write back tonight and send my best wishes.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，看！我收到一张北京的明信片。
本：哇，谁寄的？
安娜：表哥汤姆。他说那里晴天，吃得也好。
本：上面贴了张漂亮的邮票。
安娜：今晚我回信，送上祝福。

lessons.title: Greetings from afar
lessons.en: When we travel, we can send postcards to friends and family. Write the address clearly, stick on a stamp, and drop the card into a mailbox. People love to see new pictures, hear about the weather, and read your wishes. A small postcard can travel thousands of kilometres and tell others, "I miss you and I'm thinking of you."
lessons.cn: 旅行时可以给亲友寄明信片。写清地址，贴上邮票，投进邮筒。人们喜欢看新照片、了解天气、读你的祝福。小小明信片能跨越数千公里，告诉别人"我想你"。

lessons.title: Different but lovely
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, I met a foreign student today. She speaks three languages!
Ben: Amazing! What country is she from?
Anna: From Japan. She uses chopsticks like us.
Ben: Different cultures have so much in common.
Anna: Right! We can learn from each other and respect different ways.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我今天遇见一个留学生，她会说三种语言！
本：太厉害了！她哪国人？
安娜：日本，她也用筷子。
本：不同文化有很多相通之处。
安娜：对！我们可以彼此学习、尊重差异。

lessons.title: One world, many cultures
lessons.en: Our world has thousands of cultures. People speak different languages, eat different food, and celebrate different festivals. In China, we use chopsticks. In Italy, people eat pasta with a fork. Each culture is amazing in its own way. Travel and read books, then you'll understand and respect different cultures. The world becomes much bigger.
lessons.cn: 我们的世界有成千上万种文化。人们说不同语言、吃不同食物、过不同节日。中国人用筷子，意大利人用叉子吃面。每种文化都有独特之美。旅行、读书，让你理解并尊重不同文化，世界从此变大了。

lessons.title: Be safe on the trip
lessons.en:
Mum: Anna, you and Ben will travel alone next week. Be safe!
Anna: Don't worry, Mum. We'll follow all the rules.
Mum: Remember the family phone number. Stay away from danger.
Anna: I'll be careful. We'll also watch for warning signs.
Ben: Yes! Safety first.
lessons.cn:
妈妈：安娜，下周你和本要单独旅行，注意安全！
安娜：放心妈妈，我们会遵守规则。
妈妈：记住家里电话，远离危险。
安娜：我会小心，会留意警示牌。
本：对，安全第一。

lessons.title: Safety on the road
lessons.en: Travel is fun, but safety always comes first. Always cross the road with the green light. Don't talk to strangers. Carry a small bag with water, a map and a phone. Read warning signs at scenic spots and follow the rules. Remember a family phone number — call right away if you get lost. A safe trip is a happy trip!
lessons.cn: 旅行有趣，但安全第一。绿灯过马路。不和陌生人说话。带小包装水、地图、电话。看景区警示牌、守规则。记住家人电话——迷路马上打。安全的旅行才是快乐的旅行！

lessons.title: Telling my story
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, this summer journey was wonderful!
Ben: Yes. The mountain, the beach, and the city — what fun memories!
Anna: I wrote everything in my diary.
Ben: Let's share the photos with the class.
Anna: Thank you, Ben, for travelling with me.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，这个夏天的旅程太棒了！
本：是的，山、海滩、城市——多么美好的回忆！
安娜：我都写到日记里了。
本：我们和班里同学分享照片吧。
安娜：谢谢你，本，陪我一起旅行。

lessons.title: My summer journey
lessons.en: My summer journey was full of wonderful moments. We climbed mountains, swam in the sea, and made friends with kids from another city. I learned to ask the way in English and pay for souvenirs by myself. My diary has fifty pages of stories now. I will share them with my classmates. A journey is the best teacher, and thank you, summer!
lessons.cn: 我的夏日旅程满是精彩瞬间。我们爬山、游海、与外地小伙伴交朋友。我学会用英语问路、自己付钱买纪念品。日记已经写了五十页故事。我要和同学分享。旅行是最好的老师，谢谢你，夏天！

lessons.title: Goodbye, primary school
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, soon we'll graduate from primary school.
Ben: I know. Six years pass so fast. So many memories!
Anna: Junior high will bring new challenges.
Ben: But I feel confident — we have great teachers and friends.
Anna: Yes, the future looks bright!
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我们快小学毕业了。
本：是啊，六年过得真快，那么多回忆！
安娜：初中会有新挑战。
本：但我很自信——我们有好老师和好朋友。
安娜：是的，未来很光明！

lessons.title: Ready for junior
lessons.en: Six years in primary school will soon end. We learned to read English, do Maths, and care for each other. Junior high will bring more subjects and harder tests. But we are ready. With good study habits and a strong heart, every challenge is a chance to grow. Goodbye primary, hello junior — welcome, future!
lessons.cn: 小学六年即将结束。我们学会了读英语、做数学、彼此关心。初中将带来更多科目和更难的考试。但我们准备好了。带着良好的学习习惯和坚强的心，每个挑战都是成长的机会。再见小学，你好初中——欢迎，未来！

lessons.title: What's your dream?
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, what's your dream job?
Ben: I want to be a doctor and help people.
Anna: Cool! I want to be a writer and tell good stories.
Ben: My brother wants to be an engineer.
Anna: As long as we work hard, every dream can come true.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，你梦想做什么？
本：当医生，帮助别人。
安娜：酷！我想当作家，讲好故事。
本：我哥想当工程师。
安娜：只要努力，梦想都能成真。

lessons.title: Dreams shape our future
lessons.en: Every child has a dream job. Some children dream of being doctors and saving lives. Others want to be teachers, sharing knowledge with the young. Engineers build bridges and roads. Scientists explore the secrets of the universe. Writers tell stories that touch our hearts. Whatever your dream is, work hard, and one day it will come true.
lessons.cn: 每个孩子都有梦想职业。有的想当医生救人。有的想当老师传道授业。工程师建桥修路。科学家探索宇宙奥秘。作家用故事打动人心。无论你的梦想是什么，努力下去，总有一天会成真。

lessons.title: My hero
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, who is your hero?
Ben: My hero is my grandpa. He saved a child from a fire when he was young.
Anna: Wow, so brave!
Ben: Heroes are not only in films. Police, firefighters and doctors are heroes too.
Anna: Right. Even kind classmates can be small heroes.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，谁是你的英雄？
本：我爷爷。他年轻时从火场救过一个孩子。
安娜：哇，好勇敢！
本：英雄不只在电影里。警察、消防员、医生都是英雄。
安娜：对，连善良的同学也是小小英雄。

lessons.title: Heroes around us
lessons.en: Real heroes are all around us. A firefighter runs into a burning building to save a stranger. A teacher works late to help slow learners. A doctor stays awake all night to care for a patient. A kid shares his lunch with a hungry friend. Heroes do brave and kind things, big or small. We can all be heroes in our own way.
lessons.cn: 真正的英雄就在我们身边。消防员冲进火场救陌生人。老师加班辅导学习吃力的孩子。医生彻夜守护病人。小朋友把午饭分给挨饿的伙伴。英雄做勇敢善良的事，无论大小。我们都能用自己的方式成为英雄。

lessons.title: Match day
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, are you ready for the football match today?
Ben: Of course! Our team has practised for two weeks.
Anna: I'll cheer for you. Last year you were the champion.
Ben: Sport gives me energy and friends.
Anna: I love running too. Let's keep doing sports for life.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，今天足球比赛准备好了吗？
本：当然！我们队练了两周。
安娜：我给你加油，你去年是冠军呢。
本：运动让我有活力，有朋友。
安娜：我也爱跑步，一辈子坚持运动！

lessons.title: Sports for life
lessons.en: Sport is more than a game. Football and basketball teach us teamwork. Swimming and running build a strong body. Win or lose, every match makes us better. Champions are not born — they practise every day. Start a sport early and you'll stay healthy, full of energy, and friends, for your whole life.
lessons.cn: 运动不只是游戏。足球篮球教我们团队精神。游泳跑步强健体魄。无论输赢，每场比赛都让我们更好。冠军不是天生的——他们每天练。早开始一项运动，你一辈子都会健康、有活力、有朋友。

上.title: Unit 5 You Are What You Eat

lessons.title: You are what you eat
lessons.en:
Mum: Anna, eat more vegetables. They have vitamins.
Anna: Mum, can I have some chips too?
Mum: A little junk food is OK, but too much fat is bad.
Anna: I know. Healthy food gives me energy.
Mum: Right. Balance is the key.
lessons.cn:
妈妈：安娜，多吃蔬菜，有维生素。
安娜：妈，我能吃点薯片吗？
妈妈：偶尔可以，但太多脂肪不好。
安娜：知道，健康食物让我有活力。
妈妈：对，平衡是关键。

lessons.title: Balance your plate
lessons.en: Doctors say, "You are what you eat." If we eat too much junk food, we get tired and weak. Fresh vegetables, fruit, milk and meat give us vitamins, calcium and energy. A balanced plate has different colours — green, red, yellow, brown. Cook some, eat some raw. Drink water, not just sweet drinks. A good diet is the first step to a strong life.
lessons.cn: 医生说"你吃什么就成什么"。垃圾食品吃多就会无力。新鲜蔬菜、水果、牛奶和肉提供维生素、钙和能量。平衡的餐盘有不同颜色——绿、红、黄、棕。有些煮，有些生吃。多喝水，少喝甜饮。好的饮食是强健生活的第一步。

lessons.title: Save our Earth
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, pollution is so bad now. We must do something.
Ben: Let's start small — recycle paper, plastic and glass.
Anna: We can plant a tree on Earth Day.
Ben: And save water at home. The river near us is too dirty.
Anna: Right. Every small action protects our Earth.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，污染太严重了，得做点什么。
本：从小事做起——回收纸、塑料、玻璃。
安娜：地球日我们种棵树。
本：在家节约用水。我们附近的河太脏了。
安娜：对，每件小事都在保护地球。

lessons.title: Our only home
lessons.en: Earth is our only home. Air and river pollution hurt people, animals and plants. Plastic stays in the soil for hundreds of years. We must recycle, save water, and turn off lights when leaving a room. Plant a tree every spring. Choose a bike instead of a car for short trips. A clean Earth needs the help of every person, every day.
lessons.cn: 地球是我们唯一的家。空气和河流污染伤害人、动物和植物。塑料在土里几百年不分解。我们要回收、节水、出门关灯。每年春天种棵树。短途骑车不开车。干净的地球需要每个人每天的努力。

lessons.title: Amazing inventions
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, what invention do you love most?
Anna: The phone, because I can talk to Grandma far away.
Ben: I love the internet — I can learn anything online.
Anna: Robots can help in hospitals and homes too.
Ben: Inventions really change our lives. The future will be amazing!
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，你最爱什么发明？
安娜：电话，能和远方奶奶说话。
本：我爱互联网，能在线学任何东西。
安娜：机器人也能帮助医院和家庭。
本：发明真的改变生活。未来会更精彩！

lessons.title: Inventions that changed the world
lessons.en: Some inventions changed the world forever. Paper helped knowledge travel far. The light bulb turned dark nights bright. The computer and the internet brought people from across the world together. Today, robots help doctors do small surgery. Tomorrow, maybe cars will drive themselves to school. Inventors keep dreaming, and the world keeps growing.
lessons.cn: 有些发明永远改变了世界。纸让知识传得远。电灯泡照亮黑夜。电脑和互联网把世界各地的人连在一起。今天机器人帮医生做小手术。明天也许汽车自己开去学校。发明家不断梦想，世界不断成长。

lessons.title: Friends forever
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, we've been friends for six years. I'll miss you in junior high.
Ben: Don't worry — true friendship lasts forever.
Anna: We can still share stories on the phone.
Ben: We help each other and forgive each other.
Anna: Yes, trust and kindness keep our friendship strong.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我们做了六年朋友，上初中我会想你。
本：别担心，真正的友谊永远长存。
安娜：我们可以电话分享故事。
本：我们互相帮助，互相原谅。
安娜：对，信任和善良让友谊牢固。

lessons.title: What makes a true friend
lessons.en: What makes a true friend? First, trust — we tell our secrets to a friend we trust. Second, kindness — a friend smiles and listens. Third, help — a friend stands beside us when we are sad. Finally, forgiveness — friends sometimes make mistakes, but they say sorry and move on. True friendship lasts through the years, and even far apart, two hearts stay close.
lessons.cn: 什么是真朋友？第一是信任——把秘密告诉信任的朋友。第二是善良——朋友会微笑会倾听。第三是帮助——伤心时朋友陪在身边。最后是原谅——朋友会犯错，但能道歉、向前看。真正的友谊跨越岁月，即使相隔遥远，两颗心也紧紧相连。

lessons.title: Goodbye and hello
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, six years are over. It's time to say goodbye.
Ben: Goodbye to primary, hello to junior!
Anna: Let's set a goal: read 20 English books this summer.
Ben: I believe we can do it.
Anna: Thank you, friends and teachers. The future is bright!
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，六年结束了，要说再见了。
本：再见小学，你好初中！
安娜：定个目标：暑假读 20 本英文书。
本：我相信我们能做到。
安娜：谢谢朋友和老师，未来一片光明！

lessons.title: A bright future
lessons.en: Today we say goodbye to primary school. Six years gave us knowledge, courage and good friends. Believe in yourself — set goals, work hard, and treat people with kindness. Thank our parents, teachers and classmates for the love and support. A new chapter begins in junior high. The future is bright when we walk towards it with a smile.
lessons.cn: 今天我们告别小学。六年给了我们知识、勇气和好朋友。相信自己——立目标，努力，善待他人。感谢父母、老师和同学的关爱与支持。新的篇章在初中开启。带着微笑走向未来，未来必定光明！

下.title: Unit 1 Slow and steady wins the race

lessons.title: Let's talk
lessons.en:
Janet: Jiamin, are you OK?
Jiamin: I tried to carry all the books. I didn't want to go back to the classroom again.
Janet: Why are you in such a hurry? You are like that silly hare.
Jiamin: Hare? What do you mean?
Xiaoling: You know… the old story about the tortoise and the hare.
Jiamin: Yes. One day a tortoise and a hare had a race. The hare was sure he would win so he took a rest. He was too proud and careless. The slow but careful tortoise won the race.
Janet: Ahh. I understand now. If I want to do something well, I should be careful and patient.
Xiaoling: That's right. Remember, Slow and steady wins the race.
lessons.cn:
Janet：家民，你还好吗？
Jiamin：我试着搬所有的书。我不想再回教室了。
Janet：你为什么这么匆忙？你就像那只傻兔子。
Jiamin：兔子？你什么意思？
Xiaoling：你知道……那个关于乌龟和兔子的老故事。
Jiamin：是的。一天乌龟和兔子赛跑。兔子确信自己会赢，就休息了。他太骄傲太粗心了。慢但细心的乌龟赢得了比赛。
Janet：啊。我现在明白了。如果我想把事情做好，我应该细心且有耐心。
Xiaoling：没错。记住，慢而稳，事必成。

lessons.title: Fun with language
lessons.en:
in a hurry
carry a heavy bag
have a rest
talk on the phone
ride a bike
cut a finger
lessons.cn:
匆忙
提重袋子
休息一下
电话交谈
骑自行车
切到手指

lessons.title: Sing along
lessons.en:
One, two, three, four, five. Once I caught a fish alive.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Then I let it go again.
Why did you let it go? Because it bit my finger so.
Which finger did it bite? This little finger on the right.
lessons.cn:
一、二、三、四、五。我曾抓到一条活鱼。
六、七、八、九、十。然后我又把它放了。
你为什么放它走？因为它咬了我的手指。
它咬了哪根手指？右边这根小手指。

lessons.title: Story time
lessons.en:
Kitty, the little cat, likes eating fish. She often goes fishing.
Yesterday morning she caught a lot of fish.
The old bear loves eating fish, too.
He came over and talked with Kitty, "Your friends are playing in my garden. They are having fun. And they are going to have a picnic on my farm. Go and play with them. I will look after your fish and help you catch more fish here."
Kitty was happy. She left for the garden and looked for her friends.
But when Kitty left, the old bear ate all the fish up.
lessons.cn:
小猫凯蒂喜欢吃鱼。她经常去钓鱼。
昨天早上她钓了很多鱼。
老熊也喜欢吃鱼。
他走过来和凯蒂聊天：“你的朋友们在我的花园里玩。他们很开心。他们还打算在我的农场野餐。去和他们玩吧。我会照看你的鱼，帮你在这里抓更多的鱼。”
凯蒂很高兴。她去花园找她的朋友们。
但当凯蒂离开时，老熊把鱼全吃光了。

lessons.title: Let's read
lessons.en:
One day, a farmer was working in the field.
Suddenly a hare ran very fast and crashed into a tree.
It fell to the ground and died.
The farmer was happy. He picked up the hare and took it back home.
He cooked it and had a delicious meal.
"Working in the field every day is hard work. But picking up a hare is so easy," he said to himself.
From then on, the farmer stopped working.
All day long, he sat in the field and waited for a hare to appear.
All his vegetables died. All his animals ran away.
But another hare never came, so the farmer had nothing to eat.
Don't be like the farmer. Don't wait for another hare. Go for it!
lessons.cn:
一天，一个农夫正在田里干活。
突然，一只野兔飞快地跑过来，撞到了一棵树上。
它倒在地上死了。
农夫很高兴。他捡起野兔带回了家。
他煮了它，美美地吃了一顿。
“每天在田里干活很辛苦。但捡到一只野兔太容易了，”他自言自语道。
从那时起，农夫停止了劳作。
他整天坐在田里等野兔出现。
他所有的蔬菜都枯死了。他所有的动物都跑掉了。
但再也没有野兔来，所以农夫没有东西吃。
不要像那个农夫。不要等待另一只野兔。去努力争取吧！

lessons.title: Story time
lessons.en:
Aki: Fire, fire… get out of the house!
Aki: Ha-ha-ha. There's no fire. I just wanted you to come out and play.
Boy: Aki. You mustn't tell lies. Don't you know the story of The Boy Who Cried Wolf?
Boy: Long ago, a boy was watching his sheep in the field. He felt bored so he cried out "wolf".
The villagers thought a wolf was eating their animals and they hurried to help.
The boy found this very funny so he did it many times.
Then one day, a wolf really came. The boy cried out for help but this time no one came.
The people didn't believe the boy any more and the wolf ate all the sheep.
Boy: So you see, Aki. You must always tell the truth.
lessons.cn:
Aki：着火了，着火了……快跑出房子！
Aki：哈哈哈。没有火。我只是想让你们出来玩。
Boy：阿基。你不能说谎。你不知道《狼来了》的故事吗？
Boy：很久以前，一个男孩在田野里放羊。他觉得无聊，就大喊“狼来了”。
村民们以为狼在吃他们的牲畜，急忙赶来帮忙。
男孩觉得这很有趣，于是他做了很多次。
后来有一天，狼真的来了。男孩大喊救命，但这次没人来。
人们不再相信这个男孩，狼吃掉了所有的羊。
Boy：所以你看，阿基。你必须永远说真话。

lessons.title: Let's talk
lessons.en:
Jiamin: Let's play a game. Can you guess this animal's name? It has two strong back legs and can jump very far.
Janet: Hmm... that's difficult. A frog?
Jiamin: No. It's a kangaroo. My turn. This animal looks like a star and it lives in the ocean. What is it?
Ben: Is it a starfish?
Jiamin: Yes, it is. You try, Janet.
Janet: It's a very large animal. It has a long nose and two big ears. It likes eating plants.
Xiaoling: It's an elephant.
Janet: Right. It loves eating meat. It is also called the "King of the Animals".
Ben: A tiger? / A lion? Tigers live in Asia, not Africa.
Janet: Yes, a lion.
lessons.cn:
Jiamin：我们来玩个游戏。你能猜出这种动物的名字吗？它有两条强壮的后腿，能跳得很远。
Janet：嗯……很难。是青蛙吗？
Jiamin：不。是袋鼠。轮到我了。这种动物看起来像星星，生活在海里。是什么？
Ben：是海星吗？
Jiamin：是的。珍妮特，你试试。
Janet：它是一种非常大的动物。它有一个长鼻子和两只大耳朵。它喜欢吃植物。
Xiaoling：是大象。
Janet：对。它喜欢吃肉。它也被称为“百兽之王”。
Ben：老虎？/狮子？老虎生活在亚洲，不在非洲。
Janet：是的，狮子。

lessons.title: Rhyme time
lessons.en:
Monkey, monkey, rides on a donkey.
Fox, fox, sits on the box.
Parrot, parrot, eats a carrot.
Mouse, mouse, hides behind the house.
Frog, frog, sits on a log.
Tiger, tiger, jumps through the fire.
lessons.cn:
猴子，猴子，骑在驴子上。
狐狸，狐狸，坐在箱子上。
鹦鹉，鹦鹉，吃着胡萝卜。
老鼠，老鼠，躲在房子后面。
青蛙，青蛙，坐在木头上。
老虎，老虎，跳过火圈。

lessons.title: Language focus
lessons.en:
Billy was a little bird. He lived in the forest. In the forest, there were many birds, too. But Billy didn't work or play with them.
"Winter is coming. But I don't have a warm house. I must build a new one. I am not going to build a small one. I'm going to build a big and warm one," he said to himself.
"But will the other birds help me? I don't think they will, because they don't like me. And they are playing games happily over there."
Feeling sad, Billy started to build his new home alone. Suddenly, a lot of birds came up to him.
"We have all come to help you, Billy," they said.
Billy was surprised and said, "I didn't tell you I would build a house. How did you know?"
"We were not playing. We were working, too. We saw that you were busy. We think that we can do something for you," said one of the birds.
Billy was moved. "Thank you," Billy said. From then on, Billy didn't work or play alone. He had many friends. And he often helped them, too.
lessons.cn:
比利是一只小鸟。他住在森林里。森林里也有很多鸟。但比利不和他们一起干活或玩耍。
“冬天来了。但我没有温暖的家。我必须建一个新家。我不想建小的。我要建一个又大又暖和的，”他自言自语道。
“但其他鸟会帮我吗？我不认为他们会，因为他们不喜欢我。他们在那边开心地玩游戏。”
比利感到难过，开始独自建造新家。突然，很多鸟来到他面前。
“我们都来帮你了，比利，”他们说。
比利很惊讶，说：“我没有告诉你们我要建房子。你们怎么知道的？”
“我们没有在玩。我们也在干活。我们看到你很忙。我们觉得可以为你做点什么，”其中一只鸟说。
比利被感动了。“谢谢你，”比利说。从那时起，比利不再独自干活或玩耍。他有了很多朋友。他也经常帮助他们。

下.title: Unit 4 We can save the animals

lessons.title: Let's read
lessons.en:
Would you like to live in a world with no pandas, tigers or whales?
These and many other animals are in danger.
If we don't do something now, they may all disappear forever!
One problem is that their homes are disappearing.
People cut down the forests and pollute the oceans, so these animals have no place to live in.
Also, many people buy things made from these animals, like medicines, fur coats and even food.
We only have one earth!
If we work together, we can still save the animals.
lessons.cn:
你想生活在一个没有熊猫、老虎或鲸鱼的世界里吗？
这些以及许多其他动物都处于濒危状态。
如果我们现在不采取行动，它们可能会永远消失！
一个问题是它们的家园正在消失。
人们砍伐森林，污染海洋，所以这些动物没有地方居住。
而且，很多人购买由这些动物制成的东西，比如药品、皮草大衣甚至食物。
我们只有一个地球！
如果我们携手努力，我们仍然可以拯救这些动物。

lessons.title: Story time
lessons.en:
Here is an important news report. Several dangerous animals escaped from the city zoo this morning. Police are now trying to catch the animals before they hurt anyone.
Aki: Gosh!
Our reporter says the brown bear is in City Park. He is in the park lake. He is catching fish. Hmmm…he must be hungry.
The lion is in front of Star Department Store. He's walking towards a lady in a fur coat. …Maybe he thinks she is his sister.
Aki: This is so exciting.
The tiger has been found. …He is walking on a street.
Boy: Aki, look! That's my house on TV. That means…
Aki: I can see the tiger. He looks hungry. I'd better give him some dinner.
Boy: Aki. Stop! Don't open that door or you will be his dinner.
lessons.cn:
现在播报一则重要新闻。今天早上，几只危险动物从市动物园逃走了。警方正在试图抓捕这些动物，以免它们伤人。
Aki：天哪！
据记者报道，棕熊在城市公园里。他在公园的湖里抓鱼。嗯……他一定是饿了。
狮子在星星百货商场前面。他正走向一位穿着皮草大衣的女士。……也许他以为那是他的姐妹。
Aki：这太刺激了。
老虎已经被发现。……他正在一条街上走着。
Boy：阿基，看！电视上那是我家。那意味着……
Aki：我能看到老虎。他看起来很饿。我最好给他点吃的。
Boy：阿基。住手！别开门，不然你会成为他的晚餐。

lessons.title: Let's talk
lessons.en:
Ben: What are you reading, Xiaoling?
Xiaoling: A book about Dr Sun Yatsen.
Ben: Who is he?
Jiamin: He's a very famous and important person in Chinese history.
Ben: Wow! Can you tell me something about him?
Jiamin: Yes. He was a great leader. He tried to free the Chinese people and make their lives better.
Xiaoling: Yes. He loved the Chinese people and the Chinese people love him.
Jiamin: That's right. Today many roads, schools and parks have his name.
Ben: Wow, what a great man!
lessons.cn:
Ben：小玲，你在看什么？
Xiaoling：一本关于孙中山先生的书。
Ben：他是谁？
Jiamin：他是中国历史上非常有名和重要的人物。
Ben：哇！你能告诉我一些关于他的事吗？
Jiamin：好的。他是一位伟大的领袖。他努力解放中国人民，让他们过上更好的生活。
Xiaoling：是的。他爱中国人民，中国人民也爱他。
Jiamin：没错。如今很多道路、学校和公园都以他的名字命名。
Ben：哇，真是个伟人！

lessons.title: Fun with language · Mozart
lessons.en: Mozart was a famous musician. He was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He began to play the piano when he was four. He loved the piano and played it every day. He began to write music when he was five years old. Everyone liked Mozart's music, but he didn't make a lot of money. He was very poor. He became ill and died when he was only 35 years old.
lessons.cn: 莫扎特是一位著名的音乐家。他于1756年出生在奥地利的萨尔茨堡。他四岁时开始弹钢琴，非常热爱钢琴，每天都练习。五岁时，他就开始创作音乐了。所有人都喜欢莫扎特的音乐，但他并没有赚到很多钱，生活很贫穷。后来他生病了，年仅35岁就去世了。

lessons.title: Language focus · 对话1
lessons.en:
Jim: Are you in the kitchen, Mum?
Mum: Yes, I am.
Jim: Are you cooking dinner?
Mum: No, I'm washing the bowls and plates. We're going to have dinner at a restaurant.
Jim: Are we going to have dinner at the restaurant near our school?
Mum: Yes. It's famous for chicken.
Jim: Great! Is Dad going to have dinner with us?
Mum: Yes, he is.
lessons.cn:
Jim：妈妈，你在厨房吗？
Mum：是的。
Jim：你在做晚饭吗？
Mum：不，我在洗碗和盘子。我们要去餐厅吃晚饭。
Jim：我们要去学校附近的餐厅吃饭吗？
Mum：是的。那里以鸡肉闻名。
Jim：太好了！爸爸会和我们一起吃晚饭吗？
Mum：是的。

lessons.title: Language focus · 对话2
lessons.en:
Jim: Look at this photo, Mum. Is this young man in white my dad?
Mum: Yes, it is.
Jim: Is he having a race in the photo?
Mum: Yes. Your father was good at running, you know.
Jim: Did he win this race?
Mum: Yes, he did.
lessons.cn:
Jim：妈妈，看这张照片。这个穿白衣服的年轻人是爸爸吗？
Mum：是的。
Jim：照片里他在赛跑吗？
Mum：是的。你知道，你爸爸以前很擅长跑步。
Jim：他赢了这场比赛吗？
Mum：是的，他赢了。

lessons.title: Language focus · 对话3
lessons.en:
Jim: Was Dad a famous sportsman when he was young?
Mum: Yes, he was. He became a PE teacher when you were two.
Jim: Did you love him because he was famous?
Mum: Yes. But I also loved him because he is kind and patient. Do you want to be a sportsman like him?
Jim: Of course. Does he still run fast now?
Mum: I think so.
lessons.cn:
Jim：爸爸年轻时是著名的运动员吗？
Mum：是的。你两岁时他成为了一名体育老师。
Jim：你是因为他出名才爱他的吗？
Mum：是的。但我也爱他，因为他善良又有耐心。你想像他一样成为运动员吗？
Jim：当然。他现在还跑得快吗？
Mum：我想是的。

lessons.title: Rhyme time
lessons.en:
The night is beautiful.
So the faces of my people.
The stars are beautiful.
So the eyes of my people.
Beautiful, also, is the sun.
Beautiful, also, are the souls of my people.
lessons.cn:
夜晚是美丽的。
我的同胞们的脸庞也是。
星星是美丽的。
我的同胞们的眼睛也是。
太阳，同样美丽。
我的同胞们的灵魂，同样美丽。

lessons.title: 扩展阅读 · Helen Keller
lessons.en: Helen Keller was born in America in 1880. When she was 19 months old, she fell ill and became deaf and blind. Her family found her a teacher, Anne Sullivan. Anne taught Helen to spell words on her hand. Helen studied hard. She finished university and travelled around the world to help others like herself. She wrote books, gave lectures and showed everyone that disabilities don't stop a person from living a meaningful life.
lessons.cn: 海伦·凯勒于1880年出生在美国。她19个月大时生病，变得又聋又瞎。她的家人为她找了一位老师，安妮·莎莉文。安妮教海伦在她的手上拼写单词。海伦学习非常努力。她完成了大学学业，周游世界去帮助像她一样的人。她写书、演讲，向大家证明残疾并不能阻止一个人过上有意义的生活。

下.title: Unit 6 Early years of Deng Jiaxian

lessons.title: Let's read
lessons.en:
Deng Jiaxian(1924-1986) is often called the father of Chinese atomic science. During his life he helped China to become a stronger and safer country.
Deng was born in Anhui Province on June 25, 1924. As a child he loved to study and wanted to be a teacher like his father, a famous professor. But his dad wanted Deng to study science to help China become a modern country.
Because he loved his father and his country, Deng studied hard and went to university. After finishing his university study in 1945, he taught physics at several middle schools and later at Beijing University.
In 1948 Deng went to the United States to study for a doctor's degree in physics. This study usually takes four or more years. But the clever young man worked hard and did it in only two years. He was the youngest person in his class, so they called him the "Baby Doctor".
lessons.cn:
邓稼先(1924-1986)常被称为中国原子科学之父。在他一生中，他帮助中国成为一个更强大、更安全的国家。
邓稼先于1924年6月25日出生在安徽省。小时候他热爱学习，想成为像他父亲一样的老师——一位著名的教授。但他的父亲希望邓稼先学习科学，帮助中国成为一个现代化国家。
因为爱父亲、爱祖国，邓稼先努力学习，考上了大学。1945年大学毕业后，他在几所中学教物理，后来在北京大学任教。
1948年，邓稼先赴美国攻读物理学博士学位。这个学位通常需要四年或更长时间。但这个聪明的年轻人非常努力，仅用两年就完成了。他是班上最年轻的学生，因此被称为“娃娃博士”。

lessons.title: Fun with language · J.K. Rowling
lessons.en:
Joanne Kathleen Rowling was born in Bristol, England, in 1965. She dreamed of being a famous writer when she was a little girl.
Before she wrote Harry Potter, she was very poor. She had no job, and a young daughter to take care of. She decided to write the Harry Potter story to make some money. Every day, she sat at a coffee shop writing until the first book was finished. But no one wanted to put out her book. They said girls couldn't write about magic. Then Rowling changed her name from Joanne Kathleen to J.K., so people wouldn't know she was a woman.
At last, in 1997, someone agreed to put out the first book and it was a huge success. She then wrote six more Harry Potter books. In just a few years, J.K. Rowling went from a poor young woman to the most-loved and richest writer in the world.
lessons.cn:
乔安妮·凯瑟琳·罗琳1965年出生于英国布里斯托尔。她从小就梦想成为一名著名作家。
在写《哈利·波特》之前，她非常贫穷，没有工作，还要照顾年幼的女儿。为了赚钱，她决定写《哈利·波特》的故事。她每天都坐在咖啡馆里写作，直到完成第一本书。但当时没人愿意出版她的书，他们说女孩不擅长写魔法题材。于是罗琳把名字改成了J.K.，这样别人就不知道她是女性了。
最终在1997年，有人同意出版她的第一本书，并且大获成功。之后她又写了另外六本《哈利·波特》系列。短短几年间，J.K.罗琳从一个贫穷的年轻女性，变成了世界上最受喜爱、最富有的作家之一。

Boy：或者你可以演奏超棒的音乐，让所有人都跟着唱歌跳舞，就像Lady Gaga那样。

下.title: Unit 7 It's the polite thing to do

lessons.title: Let's talk
lessons.en:
Jiamin: Hey, Ben! What will you do if you see an old lady standing on the bus?
Ben: That's easy. If she does not have a seat, I will give her my seat. Why?
Jiamin: Well, today on the bus, I stood up to give my seat to an old lady. But before I could say anything to her, a young man quickly sat down.
Ben: How impolite! We should always give our seat to people in need. It's the polite thing to do.
Xiaoling: That's right. I don't like impolite people. Yesterday, as I waited in line at the supermarket, a girl tried to push in. She didn't even say "Excuse me".
Janet: People should always wait for their turn. If the line is long, don't push in. Be patient!
lessons.cn:
Jiamin：嘿，本！如果你在公交车上看到一位老奶奶站着，你会怎么做？
Ben：很简单。如果她没有座位，我会把座位让给她。怎么了？
Jiamin：嗯，今天在公交车上，我站起来给一个老奶奶让座。但我还没来得及说什么，一个年轻男人就迅速坐下了。
Ben：太不礼貌了！我们应该总是给有需要的人让座。这才是礼貌的做法。
Xiaoling：没错。我不喜欢不礼貌的人。昨天我在超市排队时，一个女孩想插队。她甚至没说“对不起”。
Janet：人们应该总是按顺序等候。如果队伍很长，不要插队。耐心点！

lessons.page: Fun with language · Read and answer
lessons.title: Fun with language · Read and answer · Manners around the world
lessons.en:
People from different places greet each other in different ways. In America, people will greet each other with a handshake. But in Japan, instead of a handshake, a person will bow from the waist. The younger you are, the lower you bow. In European countries like Italy, Greece, and Russia, people often greet each other with a kiss.
In some countries like Egypt and Iran, people like to stand close to each other when they talk. In other countries, such as China and Korea, people stand far apart when they talk. They feel unhappy if you stand too near.
And when you eat dinner at someone's home in India, it's rude to eat with your left hand. If you don't use your right hand, people will think you hate the food.
The world is an interesting place but learning the manners of different countries takes time.
lessons.cn:
不同地方的人有不同的问候方式。在美国，人们见面时会握手。但在日本，人们会弯腰鞠躬，而不是握手。年纪越小，鞠躬的幅度越大。在意大利、希腊和俄罗斯等欧洲国家，人们经常用亲吻来问候对方。
在埃及和伊朗等国家，人们交谈时喜欢站得很近。而在中国和韩国等国家，人们交谈时会站得比较远。如果你站得太近，他们会感到不舒服。
在印度，当你在别人家吃饭时，用左手吃饭是不礼貌的。如果你不用右手，人们会认为你讨厌这些食物。
世界是一个有趣的地方，但学习不同国家的礼仪需要时间。

lessons.title: Rhyme time
lessons.en:
Sometimes I am good.
Sometimes I am bad.

Sometimes my parents are sad.
When I am good, my parents are glad.
When I am bad, my parents are sad.
I want them to be glad.
I don't want them to be sad.
So I will always be good.
I will never, never be bad.
lessons.cn:
有时我很乖。
有时我调皮。
有时爸妈很开心。
有时爸妈很伤心。
我乖的时候，爸妈很开心。
我调皮的时候，爸妈很伤心。
我想让他们开心。
我不想让他们伤心。
所以我要一直乖乖的。
我永远、永远不调皮。

lessons.title: Language focus · 阅读短文
lessons.en:
Manners can be quite different in different countries. When you go to a foreign country, you should learn something about its manners first.
In China when people meet, they often ask each other "Where are you going?" or "Have you had your meal?" But in England, people talk about the weather. English people do not ask others about age, salary or the price of their home. When your mouth is full of food, don't talk with others. In Thailand, you can't touch a child's head.
Good manners make things easier. They can help people to get on well with each other. When you are nice to people, they will be nice to you, too.
lessons.cn:
不同国家的礼仪差异很大。当你去国外时，应该先了解一下当地的礼仪。
在中国，人们见面时经常会问“你要去哪？”或“吃饭了吗？”。但在英国，人们会聊天气。英国人不会问别人的年龄、工资或房价。嘴里有食物时，不要和别人说话。在泰国，不能摸孩子的头。
好的礼仪能让事情更顺利，帮助人们友好相处。你对别人友善，别人也会对你友善。

lessons.title: Let's read
lessons.en:
Long ago, a little boy was walking through a park. In the middle of the park there was a tree with a sign on it. The sign said, "I am a magic tree. Say the magic words and you will see."
The boy tried to guess the magic words. He tried "open", "hurry", and many more, but none of them worked.
Tired and upset, the boy cried out, "This is too difficult. Please, dear tree!"
Suddenly, a big door opened at the bottom of the tree. Inside everything was dark, except for a sign. The sign said, "Carry on with your magic."
Then the boy said, "Thank you, dear tree!" With this, the inside of the tree lit up brightly and showed a road. The road led to a room full of toys and chocolates.
The little boy brought all his friends to the magic tree, and they had the best party ever. This is why people always say that "please" and "thank you" are the magic words.
lessons.cn:
很久很久以前，一个小男孩正在公园里散步。公园中间有一棵树，树上挂着一块牌子，上面写着：“我是一棵魔法树。说出魔法咒语，你就能看到奇迹。”
男孩试着猜魔法咒语。他试了“打开”“快点”，还有好多别的词，但没有一个管用。
又累又沮丧的男孩喊道：“这太难了。求求你了，亲爱的树！”
突然，树的底部打开了一扇大门。里面一片漆黑，只有一块牌子，上面写着：“继续用你的魔法。”
男孩接着说：“谢谢你，亲爱的树！”话音刚落，树里面一下子亮了起来，出现了一条路。这条路通向一个装满玩具和巧克力的房间。
小男孩把所有朋友都带到了魔法树这儿，他们办了一场有史以来最棒的派对。这就是为什么人们总说，“请”和“谢谢”才是真正的魔法咒语。

lessons.title: Fun with language · Ted the polite bear
lessons.en:
Ted is a bear with good manners. He is kind and helpful. When he sees others in trouble, he always tries his best to help them.
Ted always wears clean clothes when he goes out. When he meets his friends, he always says hello to them. He shows respect to others.
Ted often says, "Can I help you, please?" When he sees the old sheep carrying heavy bags, he often says, "Can I help you? Can I carry the bags for you?" When he meets the baby duck at the door, he will say, "Can I help you? Can I open the door for you?" When the little chicken can't find her way home, he says, "Can I help you? Can I take you home?"
lessons.cn:
泰德是一只有礼貌的小熊。他善良又乐于助人。看到别人遇到困难时，他总会尽力帮忙。
泰德出门时总是穿着干净的衣服。遇到朋友时，他总会主动问好，尊重别人。
泰德经常说：“请问，我能帮你吗？”看到老绵羊提着沉重的袋子，他会说：“我能帮你吗？我帮你提袋子吧？”遇到门口的小鸭子，他会说：“我能帮你吗？我帮你开门吧？”小鸡找不到回家的路时，他会说：“我能帮你吗？我送你回家吧？”

lessons.title: Story time
lessons.en:
Boy: Hi, Aki. Thanks for coming. I hope you enjoy the dinner.
Aki: Great. I'm so hungry.

Boy：哦……那我看看家里有没有。
Aki：算了，我喜欢土豆，那我就吃这些吧。
Aki：现在电视上有什么？这里好无聊啊。
Boy：阿基……那是我正在看的节目。
Boy：哦，都这么晚了？阿基，你该回家了。明天我们得好好聊聊什么是礼貌。

Ben：我想去南非。我喜欢大自然，在南非我能看到很多美丽的山脉和森林。

lessons.title: Fun with language · Daniel's move to Sydney
lessons.en:
Emma and George live in Sydney. They go to school in the city. There is a new student in their class. His name is Daniel. Daniel used to live in the countryside.
"When did you come to Sydney?" asks Emma.
"I came to Sydney last month," answers Daniel. "It's very different from my old home!"
"Tell us about your old home," says George.
"It was in the country," says Daniel. "We lived in a big house on a farm. Our farm had many sheep and cows. I had two dogs, too. We worked very hard every day. But there was not much rain. We didn't have water for the animals so we moved to the city."
"Don't worry, Daniel, you'll like living in Sydney," say Emma and George.
lessons.cn:
艾玛和乔治住在悉尼，他们在城里上学。班里来了个新同学，叫丹尼尔。丹尼尔以前住在乡下。
“你是什么时候来悉尼的？”艾玛问。
“我上个月来的，”丹尼尔回答，“这里和我以前的家很不一样！”
“给我们讲讲你以前的家吧，”乔治说。
“以前在乡下，”丹尼尔说，“我们住在农场的一栋大房子里。农场里有很多羊和牛，我还有两只狗。我们每天都很辛苦地干活。但雨很少，没有足够的水给动物喝，所以我们搬到了城里。”
“别担心，丹尼尔，你会喜欢住在悉尼的，”艾玛和乔治说。

lessons.title: Language focus · Mr Brown's trip to Hawaii
lessons.en:
Mr Brown likes travelling. He often travels with his friends when he has time.
They went to Hawaii last month. They stayed there for a week. When they were at the beautiful beach, they swam in the sea, sunbathed, went boating and watched the pretty dances. All of them had a good time. They liked the island very much. They are going to travel there again next time. "We will stay there for longer and take more photos," they say.
lessons.cn:
布朗先生喜欢旅行。他有空的时候，经常和朋友一起去旅行。
上个月他们去了夏威夷，在那里待了一周。在美丽的海滩上，他们在海里游泳、晒太阳、划船，还观看了精彩的舞蹈表演。所有人都玩得很开心，他们非常喜欢这座岛。下次他们还打算再去一次，说：“我们会待更久，拍更多照片。”

下.title: Unit 10 I can't wait to see you

lessons.title: Let's read · A letter to John
lessons.en:
Hi, John,
Thanks so much for inviting me to visit you in Canada. I can't wait to see you.
I'm very excited to stay with your family. I can speak English every day and learn more about your country. And I can save money, too. Don't worry, I will buy you a present with that money.
I know Canada is famous for its natural beauty. I really want to see the beautiful lakes and waterfalls. And I plan to visit Chinatown in Toronto, too.
I finally got my passport last week and I booked my plane ticket today. I will arrive at the airport next month, on June 12th. The plane lands at 1:00 p.m. I'm so excited!
See you then,
Li Hua
lessons.cn:
你好，John：
非常感谢你邀请我去加拿大看你，我已经迫不及待想见到你了。
能住在你家我非常兴奋。我每天都能说英语，还能更多地了解你们的国家，同时也能省钱。别担心，我会用这笔钱给你买个礼物的。

lessons.title: Fun with language · A postcard from Janet
lessons.en:
Dear Jiamin,
How are you? Italy is great. I'm living in Milan. It's in the north of Italy. Milan is famous for its fashion (clothes, hair, etc.). Everyone here is so beautiful.
The food here is wonderful, too. I tried pasta, pizza, and gelato. Gelato is Italian ice cream. My Italian friend told me it is quite healthy. But it is very delicious so I don't believe him! We eat a lot of fresh bread here and people always drink red wine with dinner.
It is easy to travel from Milan to France, Switzerland and Austria. I will try to travel to some of these countries when it is holiday time!
Bye,
From Janet
lessons.cn:
亲爱的家民：
你好吗？意大利太棒了。我现在住在米兰，它在意大利北部。米兰以时尚闻名（服装、发型等），这里的每个人都特别漂亮。
这里的食物也超棒。我尝了意面、披萨和gelato。Gelato就是意大利冰淇淋。我的意大利朋友说它很健康，但它实在太好吃了，我才不信呢！我们在这里吃很多新鲜面包，人们晚餐时总会喝红酒。
从米兰去法国、瑞士和奥地利都很方便，假期的时候我打算去这些国家里的几个地方旅行！
再见，
珍妮特

lessons.title: Review · Fable — The Lion and the Mouse
lessons.en:
The Lion and the Mouse
The lion caught the mouse, but thought it was too small and let it go.
The mouse asked the lion to let it go, and the lion did.
The lion laughed and said, "You are so small. How can you help me?"
The lion was caught in a net. The mouse came and the lion was happy and thanked it.
The lion was trapped in a hunter's net.
The mouse used its teeth to chew through the net and set the lion free.

Moral: Even the small and weak can help the great and strong. Never look down on anyone.
lessons.cn:
《The Lion and the Mouse》
狮子抓住了老鼠，但觉得它太小了，放走了它。

狮子笑着说：“你这么小，以后能帮我什么？”
狮子被网困住，老鼠来救它，狮子很高兴，向它道谢。
狮子被猎人的网困住了。
老鼠用牙齿咬断网，把狮子救了出来。

寓意：弱小的人也能帮助强大的人，不要小看任何人。
